newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-HENDRY TO FACE DOHERTY IN WORLD FINAL.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-HENDRY TO FACE DOHERTY IN WORLD FINAL.

text.p: Six-times champion Stephen Hendry of Scotland beat Thai James Wattana 17-13 on Saturday to reach the world snooker championship final.
Hendry is to face Ireland's Ken Doherty in the best-of-35 frames final starting on Sunday and finishing on Monday.
The Scot was level 8-8 with Wattana overnight, and swiftly stamped his authority on their contest in the first session by taking a 12-8 lead.
Hendry subsequently needed three more frames to win their best-of-33 frames semifinal when the evening session started.
However, Wattana showed his resolve by producing breaks of 76 and 70 to close the gap on the title holder to 15-13.
But Hendry was not to be denied, taking the next two frames to subdue the Thai's challenge.
Doherty reached his first world championship final 24 hours earlier when he crushed Canadian Alan Robidoux 17-7.
